text.body: ātreyokteṣu sūtreṣu sthito'niṅgyapadānyaham ślokarūpeṇa vakṣyāmi saukaryāya supāṭhiṇām 1 niṣkaivalyaṃ ca niṣṭarkyaṃ niṣādebhyo niṣaṅgadhiḥ mahimānaṃ ca niṣkāvamāhuvadhyai madintamaḥ 2 aśvataro vatsataraiḥ kikidiviḥ vidīgayaḥ upahatnuṃ ca navatiṃ phaligaṃ ca hiraṇmayam 3 ṛdūdareṇaiḍabṛdāḥ śumbhamānā kanikradat varimāṇaṃ ca saudāsān gaupatyaṃ gautamādapi 4 uccāvacānanantakaḥ prāśṛṅgo'psarasaḥ punaḥ aṅgirasvatkṛkalāsaḥ krumukaṃ cāśuśukṣaṇiḥ 5 dhūmrimāṇaṃ svadayitā dandaśūkā anāgasaḥ harimāṇaṃ ca devebhirapi prathamaniṣkṛtau 6 sautrāmaṇyā uttaredyuranena samanehasam kṛkavākuratīkāśadatīkāśānanulbaṇam 7 prathamānaṃ tanūbhiśca pūrvedyuḥ puṇḍarisrajām duṣṭarītuśca kakubhiraṇudaṃ codakaṃ tathā 8 nābhānediṣṭhamāgnīdhrātsarṇīkāya sanīti ca gopau gopāya gobhiśca mathitvā giriśāya ca 9 avāśṛṅgajaṣau yaśca juhurāṇamayācitam dūṣikābhiratīkāśān janamānaṃ kariṣyataḥ 10 anāśīrkeṇa vasukassahamāno ghanāghanaḥ nīcakāro vājayantaḥ āyannucāditiṃti ca 11 paracchepaścakravākaḥ kṛṣamāṇaḥ pariṣkṛtaḥ acchāvākaśśroṣamāṇāḥ śobhamānā kapardinaḥ 12 mānthīlavaḥ dacāvarta gabheyaśca canohitaḥ pākalāya ca śṛṅgāṇi prāsacāya pratāyate 13 vaiśantāya avāryāya nīhārāyāyavastathā ekādaśāsaskandhebhyo vahamānā vipaścitaḥ 14 aśītimne matasnābhyāṃ varimāṇaṃ ca dampatī parikramya pravāyeta trasadasyuśca duṣṭaram 15 vāstavyaḥ śunaḥśepaṃ sāsahyāma priyaṅgavaḥ antarikṣāccāpayitā naktayā ca kapardine 16 pare pakṣe'nuvāke yā dakārādi ca tatpade ā...ya retaskāya tadvināniṅgyamiṣyate 17 ājīgartiṃ yunajate pataṅgaṃ ca sahasvatī uditaṃ hi matasnābhyāṃ snāvanyābhyāṃ pravatvati 18 upāṃśuśabdassarvatra vāvṛdhānaḥ śayaṇḍakaḥ draviṇasyuratharvāṇaḥ anamitrāya dvatsutaḥ 19 gāyatrībhiścikituṣe jagatībhiśca datvate sokṣamāṇo dātasaśca rakṣamāṇaśca vājinam 20 jāyamānassakṛtvā yathāvamānena paśyate jityai ca janiṣṭhyāya patayanta śacīpatiḥ 21 svaraṇaṃ jīvanasvāyai vṛṣadaikṣasalāvṛkī surabhīṇi samābhiśca suvitāya viniśrutiḥ 22 uto tataśca marutvanta mārjayante dṛśīkavaḥ sādhāraṇaṃ vivasvāṃśca suvite ca jihiṃsima 23 saṃskṛtyeti sarvatra bharamāṇā ayākayag pratnathādīni catvāri sadṛśaṃ svadhitiriti ca 24 īdṛśāyādi catvāri satrasyardhyā vipaścitaḥ uṣitvā prāvṛtā sā ca bījakā pippakā tathā 25 amīvā ambarīṣādvā ambarīṣe ca dundubhiḥ taidhātavīyenāmartyamaśramiṣṭhāśca viśvate 26 prāṇāyano viśvatīnāṃ cayamānā ayasmayam vaikaṅkatī sardigṛdimāśubhāca vihantavai 27 ātreya śikṣā saṃpūrṇam ātreya śikṣā atha ātreya śikṣā tṛtīyo bhāgaḥ prathamau ślokau atha kramavyutkramaṇotkramādyato jaṭā bhavedārṣajasaṃdhijasvarāt vilokya śikṣādikamādarāttataḥ prakāśyate sā viduṣāṃ mude mayā 1 padadvayanimittaṃ syādekābhāveti tatra tu saṃhitāvatkrame jñeyastadvajjñeyā jaṭā budhaiḥ 2 antimaḥ ślokaḥ prathamasya dvitīyatvaṃ pūrvaṃ kurvīta paṇḍitaḥ dhūdvakṣṇau dvandvakṣṇaṣamityatra anusvāro vidharmataḥ ityātreyaśikṣā
